definitions.short: properly, fulness or the full moon , i.e. its festival
definitions.full: H3677. kese or keseh כֶּ֫סֶא Prov 7:20 , כֶּ֫סֶה Psa 81:4 noun [masculine] full moon (compare Aramaic ; origin dubious, compare Lag Symn. i. 93 ; perhaps Assyrian loan-word; compare Assyrian kusêu , headdress or cap , = agû, id. , and also full moon (as tiara of moon-god ?), Dl HWB, sub kusêu, kubšu, agû ; yet see Brock) — הַכּ ׳לְיוֺם Prov 7:20 ; as a feast-day, ׳בַּכּ Psa 81:4 (opposed to בַּחֹדֶשׁ , at the new moon ).
